title: Vive l'Amour
transcription:
Vive l'Amour

Come every good fellow
and join in my song,
Vive la compagnie.
Success to each other and pass it along
Vive la compagnie.

Chorus:
Vive la vive la vive l'amour;
Vive la vive la vive l'amour;
Vive l'amour, vive l'amour,
Vive la compagnie.

A friend on my left
and a friend on my right
Vive la compagnie.
In love and good friendship let us unite
Vive la compagnie.

Chorus

Now wider and wider our circle expands
Vive la compagnie.
Let's sing to our comrades
in far away lands
Vive la compagnie.

Chorus
